description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure and add FaultInjectionMemoryStorage as a grain storage provider in Orleans hosting, including options configuration and dependency injection setup.

classes.name: FaultInjectionStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure FaultInjectionMemoryStorage

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionMemoryStorage
methods.description: Configures services to add FaultInjectionMemoryStorage with specified options and fault injection options, returning the modified IServiceCollection.
